about: Attorney Brad T. Wyly is co-owner and managing partner of Wyly & Cook, PLLC, law firm in Houston, Texas. A nationally ranked trial lawyer with more than 20 years of total legal experience, Mr. Wyly provides unmatched counsel and support to clients throughout the greater Houston Metro and surrounding areas who have legal needs involving any of the following:
· All types of personal injury and wrongful death claims

As an attorney, Mr. Wyly enjoys providing a voice to those who would otherwise have no legal recourse for the serious legal challenges affecting their lives and livelihood, and he has recovered millions of dollars in total compensation for his plaintiff clients. Along with personal injury and wrongful death, he has handled many insurance bad faith claims, and he has achieved remarkable success helping his clients obtain the full amount of benefits from their insurance companies following natural disasters and other calamities.

Honored for his outstanding professionalism and service, Mr. Wyly has earned an AV Preeminent peer review rating* from Martindale-Hubbell along with many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers. He has also received numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients, and he finds great reward in being able to help so many across his state during their times of dire need.

A 1998 magna cum laude graduate of The University of Texas at San Antonio, Mr. Wyly obtained his Juris Doctor from The University of Texas School of Law in 2003, where he graduated within the Top 16 of his class. While in law school, he was a member of the Texas Law Review, and he graduated with High Honors for his exceptional academic achievements.

Mr. Wyly is admitted to practice in Texas , Colorado, and New York as well as before the U.S. District Court for the Southern and Eastern Districts of Texas. He is also an active member of the Houston Bar Association, the Houston Trial Lawyers Association, Texas Trial Lawyers Association and the State Bar of Texas, among his other professional affiliations.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
